tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Smartoools RB40 AA 1.5V 2600mWh USB Type-C Rechargeable Lithium-ion Battery is a high-capacity power solution designed for modern electronic devices. Built with advanced lithium-ion technology, this battery provides a stable 1.5V constant output, ensuring reliable performance for high-drain devices such as wireless keyboards, gaming controllers, cameras, flashlights, toys, and other AA-powered electronics.


Featuring a convenient USB Type-C charging interface, the Smartoools RB40 battery allows direct charging with a standard Type-C cable, eliminating the need for a separate battery charger. The built-in LED indicator clearly displays charging status, making it easy to monitor when the battery is fully charged.


With a powerful 2600mWh capacity, the battery delivers long-lasting performance and supports up to 1000+ recharge cycles, making it a cost-effective and environmentally friendly alternative to disposable AA batteries. Its reliable output and fast charging capability make it ideal for both home and professional use.


Now available at OTECH BD, providing dependable rechargeable battery solutions for everyday devices.


Key Features


  • High capacity 2600mWh rechargeable lithium-ion battery
  • Stable 1.5V constant output for consistent device performance
  • USB Type-C direct charging without external charger
  • Built-in LED charging indicator
  • Fast charging with standard USB-C cable
  • Supports 1000+ recharge cycles
  • Advanced safety protection against overcharge, over-discharge, and short circuit
  • Eco-friendly and reusable battery solution
